title: ACORD 25 - Certificate of Liability Insurance
description: Canonical extraction target for ACORD form 25 (Fideon SPEC_00 ACORDMappingDocument, doc_type 'acord', acord_form '25'). This form is the sharpest test of confusable discrimination: the insured, the producer, the certificate holder, and up to six insurers all appear as organisation names on a single page (arch 0c).

certificate_number.description: The identifier of this certificate document. Not any policy number listed on it.

issue_date.description: The date this certificate was issued, as YYYY-MM-DD. Not a policy effective or expiration date.

insurers.description: The insurers listed in the INSURER A-F block, in the order shown. Each is a carrier bearing risk, not the producer.

letter.description: The A-F letter this insurer is assigned on the form, used by the coverage rows to reference it.

name.description: The insurer's company name as listed.

naic_code.description: The insurer's NAIC code, if shown.

coverages.description: One entry per coverage row in the certificate grid. Extract every row that carries a policy number or limit, including rows whose checkboxes are unmarked.

coverage_type.description: The coverage named on this row, for example Commercial General Liability, Automobile Liability, Umbrella, or Workers Compensation.

insurer_letter.description: The A-F letter in the INSR LTR column, linking this row to an entry in insurers.

limits.description: The limits shown for this row, keyed by the limit name as printed, for example 'each_occurrence' or 'general_aggregate'. Values are numbers without currency symbols or separators.
